arxiv-2107-07288.title: Geometric Hamiltonian matrix on the analogy between geodesic equation and Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2107-07288.creator: Jack Whongius
arxiv-2107-07288.description: Abstract By formally comparing the geodesic equation with the Schrödinger equation on Riemannian manifold, we come up with the geometric Hamiltonian matrix on Riemannian manifold based on the geospin matrix, and we discuss its eigenvalue equation as well. Meanwhile, we get the geometric Hamiltonian function only related to the scalar curvature.

arxiv-2401-15293.title: SkipViT: Speeding Up Vision Transformers with a Token-Level Skip Connection
arxiv-2401-15293.creator: Foozhan Ataiefard, Walid Ahmed, Habib Hajimolahoseini
arxiv-2401-15293.description: Abstract Vision transformers are known to be more computationally and data-intensive than CNN models. These transformer models such as ViT, require all the input image tokens to learn the relationship among them. However, many of these tokens are not informative and may contain irrelevant information such as unrelated background or unimportant scenery.

arxiv-2501-18079.title: The Möbius function on the lattice of normal subgroups
arxiv-2501-18079.creator: by
arxiv-2501-18079.description: Abstract Department of Mathematics The University of Pittsburgh Pittsburgh, PA 15260 ABSTRACT By studying lattices of normal subgroups, especially those of the socle and radical, an expression is obtained for the minimal number of conjugacy classes required to generate a group. This number is shown to be captured by the character table.

europmc-pmc2667253.creator: Cureton DK, Massol RH, Saffarian S, Kirchhausen TL, Whelan SP.
europmc-pmc2667253.description: Many viruses that enter cells by clathrin-dependent endocytosis are significantly larger than the dimensions of a typical clathrin-coated vesicle. The mechanisms by which viruses co-opt the clathrin machinery for efficient internalization remain uncertain. Here we examined how...

pmc-10655751.title: Mitigating the Rising Burden of Non-Communicable Diseases through Locally Generated Evidence-Lessons from Tanzania
pmc-10655751.creator: Harrieth P. Ndumwa, Davis E. Amani, Jackline E. Ngowi, Belinda J. Njiro, Castory Munishi, Erick A. Mboya, Doreen Mloka, Amani I. Kikula, Emmanuel Balandya, Paschal Ruggajo, Anna T. Kessy, Emilia Kitambala, Ntuli Kapologwe, James T. Kengia, James Kiologwe, Omary Ubuguyu, Bakari Salum, Appolinary Kamu
pmc-10655751.description: Background:The burden of Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) is rapidly increasing globally, and low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) bear the brunt of it. Tanzania is no exception. Addressing the rising burden of NCDs in this context calls for renewed efforts and commitment by various stakeholders.

pmc-11296827.title: NVTG-10 CLINICAL AND RADIOLOGICAL OUTCOMES OF ORBITAL METASTASES TREATED WITH STEREOTACTIC RADIOSURGERY: A SINGLE INSTITUTION RETROSPECTIVE SERIES
pmc-11296827.creator: Aroosa Zamarud, Yusuke S Hori, Ahed H Kattaa, Amit R Persad, Armine Tayag, Louisa Usttrzinsky, Sara Coleman Emrich, Scott G Soltys, Steven L Hancock, David J Park, Steven D Chang
pmc-11296827.description: INTRODUCTIONOrbital metastases (OM) are a rare complication of cancer that can result in visual impairment. Treatment options include surgery and radiotherapy, however, the optimal treatment for OM is unclear. The current evidence for stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) is limited. We aim to report the efficacy and safety of SRS in patients with OM.

pmc-11489380.title: Persistent syphilitic ocular manifestations despite treatment: a case series
pmc-11489380.creator: Sairi Zhang, Kaersti L. Rickels, Vignesh Krishnan, Sami H. Uwaydat
pmc-11489380.description: BackgroundPenicillin has remained the most effective treatment for syphilis for several decades. Syphilitic retinal manifestations may persist following treatment and cause visual problems. In this case series, we describe three syphilis patients with persistent posterior segment manifestations due to chronic inflammation, incomplete treatment, and reinfection.Case seriesRecommended initial treatment for all patients was 14 days of intravenous penicillin.

pmc-11714538.title: The ADNI4 Digital Study: A novel approach to recruitment, screening, and assessment of participants for AD clinical research
pmc-11714538.creator: Rachel L Nosheny, Melanie J Miller, Bruce Albala, Catherine C Conti, Derek Flenniken, Juliet Fockler, Winnie Kwang, Diana Truran‐Sacrey, Adam Diaz, Miriam T Ashford, Caroline Skirrow, Jack Weston, Emil Fristed, Sarah Tomaszewski Farias, Magdalena Korecka, Wan Yang, Eddie B Lee, Paul S S Aisen, Ronal
pmc-11714538.description: BackgroundScalable, efficient methods are needed to enroll diverse populations of older adults into AD observational studies and clinical trials. We evaluated preliminary feasibility of a novel, digital, culturally informed approach to recruit and screen participants for the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI4).

pmc-12417968.title: Stakeholder Pressure and Green Innovation: A Meta‐Analytic Exploration of Industry and Regional Variations
pmc-12417968.creator: Hasan Emin Gurler, Ahmet Kaya, Ayşe Nur Soysal Bilmiş, Yakup Durmaz
pmc-12417968.description: PurposeStakeholder pressure is widely recognized as a key driver of green innovation. However, existing research often overlooks how this relationship may differ across various industry settings and national contexts. Understanding these contextual differences is essential for businesses aiming to implement effective and responsive environmental strategies.Methods:This study synthesizes findings from 23 independent investigations conducted across multiple industries and countries.

pmc-12474435.title: HPV as a Molecular Hacker: Computational Exploration of HPV-Driven Changes in Host Regulatory Networks
pmc-12474435.creator: Massimiliano Chetta, Alessandra Rosati, Nenad Bukvic, Antonio Carlos de Freitas, Marcus Vinícius de Aragão Batista, Maria Angélica Ramos da Silva
pmc-12474435.description: Human Papillomavirus (HPV), particularly high-risk strains such as HPV16 and HPV18, is a leading cause of cervical cancer and a significant risk factor for several other epithelial malignancies. While the oncogenic mechanisms of viral proteins E6 and E7 are well characterized, the broader effects of HPV infection on host transcriptional regulation remain less clearly defined.

pmc-12764112.title: Adaptive engagement within a prospective registry: tracking health, occupation, and social dynamics among female sex workers in Southern Sichuan
pmc-12764112.creator: Qucheng Zhang, Jingbo Zhang, Run Chen, Xiaoxue Chen, Ticheng Xiao, Zhi Lei, Ailing Li, Song Fan
pmc-12764112.description: BackgroundFemale sex workers (FSWs) face elevated health risks, including sexually transmitted infections (STIs), mental health challenges, and violence—often exacerbated by stigma and legal constraints in China. Longitudinal research integrating health trajectories, occupational shifts, and social support remains limited but is essential for public health response.

pmc-13323534.title: Direct viral invasion and tumor-like pulmonary nodules: A fatal case of mpox in a patient with advanced HIV disease
pmc-13323534.creator: Sen Yang, Qing Yu, Yanming Zeng, Yanqiu Lu, Chao Xia, Fang Cheng, Yan Liu, Min Liu, Yemiao Chen
pmc-13323534.description: Highlights•This is the first reported fatal Mpox case with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) co-infection in Chongqing, China.•Mpox is an independent high-risk factor for immunocompromised HIV-infected patients, warranting timely screening.•Mpox pneumonia produces lung lesions radiologically mimicking tumors, emphasizing the importance of metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) testing in differential diagnosis.

pmc-13340955.title: Insights from a 6‐year hair drug analysis compendium in drug‐facilitated sexual assault cases
pmc-13340955.creator: Amandine Fort, Coralie Boudin, Hélène Eysseric‐Guerin, Virginie Scolan, Jérémy Borges, François Chiron, Pierre Henry, Françoise Stanke‐Labesque, Théo Willeman
pmc-13340955.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Drug‐facilitated sexual assault (DFSA) may involve a diverse array of substances, including illicit drugs, prescription medications, and over‐the‐counter pharmaceuticals. Hair analysis has emerged as a valuable forensic tool, offering an extended window of detection spanning several months. However, interpreting drug concentrations in hair can be challenging in forensic cases, as there are still substantial disparities in drug concentration findings across studies, or even no data available in the literature.

pmc-13385736.title: Low spatial frequency surface feature formation during femtosecond laser deep engraving: origins and mechanisms
pmc-13385736.creator: Evaldas Kažukauskas, Vytautas Jukna, Simas Butkus, Tadas Latvys, Domas Paipulas
pmc-13385736.description: In this study, we explore the formation of high-amplitude, low-spatial-frequency surface features - also commonly referred to as waviness - during laser deep engraving of dielectric materials. This unique phenomenon significantly increases surface roughness and undermines the ability to control it during deep engraving, limiting the technique’s applicability.

pmc-13441809.title: Examining physiological parameters of mental workload in the cockpit: a multimethod approach
pmc-13441809.creator: Anneke Hamann, Raphael J. Kneffel, David Cyrol, Elena Rankova, Stefan Sammito, Nils Carstengerdes

pmc-13609418.title: Pleomorphism in Soft Tissue Sarcomas: Molecular Characteristics and Clinical Features
pmc-13609418.creator: Elena E. Kopantseva, Alexey S. Rzhevskiy, Ekaterina A. Lesovaya, Vlada E. Tuliavko, Nikolay A. Kozlov, Timur I. Fetisov, Kirill I. Kirsanov, Evgeny V. Denisov, Marianna G. Yakubovskaya
pmc-13609418.description: Pleomorphism in cells encompasses a variety of morphological features, such as heterogeneity in the size and shape of cells and nuclei, irregularity of the nuclear membrane, hyperchromasia, and peculiarities of cell organelles. Pleomorphism in mammalian cells is associated with genetically unstable neoplasms and is frequently accompanied by high rates of proliferation and low differentiation status.
